mapper.select: select att_id as attId, att_name as attName, att_pic as attPic, att_capacity as attCapacity, att_comment as attComment, att_able as attAble from attraction;
mapper.insert: insert into attraction (att_name, att_pic, att_capacity, att_comment, att_able) values (#{attName}, #{attPic}, #{attCapacity}, #{attComment}, #{attAble});
